rg_stability.note: Rogan-Gladen divides by (Se+Sp-1); with the local judge's low specificity (Sp about 0.6) this denominator is small and its Beta posterior wide, so the logit-space interpolation of the RG-corrected rate is numerically unstable. When degenerate, PPI++ and the gold adjudication are the reliable corrected readouts.
